# Browser fixtures

`clinic-scan.png` is a PDFium rasterization of page 1 of `web/public/samples/referral-cover.pdf`, created for this repository with ReportLab on 18 October 2026. It contains explicitly fictional DEMO-104 records and a fictional clinic. It exercises actual local Tesseract OCR; no patient data is used. It is not a clinical form or authorization template.
